profile.name: 双通道函数/任意波形发生器
profile.description: 一台台式双通道函数/任意波形信号发生器，用于在实验室中输出正弦波、方波等标准波形以及用户自定义波形，并调节频率、幅度、偏置和输出状态。它适合用于电子电路测试、传感器激励、触发实验以及需要双通道同步或频率锁定的信号源应用。
profile.description_en: A benchtop dual-channel function/arbitrary waveform generator used in laboratories to produce standard waveforms such as sine and square waves as well as user-defined waveforms, with control over frequency, amplitude, offset, and output state. It is suitable for electronics testing, sensor excitation, trigger-based experiments, and signal-source tasks requiring two-channel synchronisation or frequency locking.
